podcast.body: This song featuring L.V. was the Billboard year-end number one for 1995, becoming an "instant hip-hop classic" upon its summer release. It was built from an interpolation of Stevie Wonder's deep cut "Pastime Paradise." Despite spending only two weeks at number one, it generated massive sales, going triple platinum in under six months. The song endured well beyond its movie origin, "Dangerous Minds," a film about an unlikely teacher, mirroring the theme of another year-end number one. "Built out of an interpolation of Stevie Wonder's Deep Cut, Pastime Paradise, Coolio's Gangsta's Paradise became an instant hip-hop classic when it arrived in the summer of 95."
